chronology: For each evaluation month, fit previous months -3/-2; calibrate previous month -1. Purge 21 minutes at fit/calibration/evaluation boundaries. All sides/symbols grouped by time; no random train/test split. Fit/calibration sampled every8min by absolute timestamp, all coins and sides kept. Train labels must EXIT strictly before next partition. Evaluation every minute, signals use previous fully closed candle and book timestamp+1s strictly before decision. Fill next minute open after full1min latency. November family selection frozen from July-Oct only. Historical price paths before November partly consulted in prior R17 research; not wholly untouched OOS.

model.calibration: logistic sigmoid of clipped model log-odds; fitted ONLY on preceding calibration month

features: causal minute returns1/3/8/20/60; distance to ema20/60 normalizedATR; realized volatility20/60; ATR14; prior20m high/low distances; taker buy ratio1/5/20; volume ratio; book notional imbalance at+/-0.2% and+/-1%; log near-depth; snapshot age; side and symbol ID. No implied OI, whale data, bid-ask prices, or simulated order book features.
book_policy: Actual archive bookDepth snapshots only. Use +/-0.2 and +/-1 percent cumulative notional, timestamp+1sec publication allowance; strict past and <=120s age. Duplicate timestamps with differing values rejected. Missing/stale book blocks book variants; price-only ablation keeps same execution calendar. No level2 queue or observed spread claimed.
label: For each side/horizon fixed triple barrier: stop clamp(2ATR14/lastclose,0.002,0.008), target2R; stop-first if samebar. Entry at decision+1min. Time exit at horizon open. Predict positive gross realized return. Class conditional payoff in unitsR and duration estimates from calibration only. No validation labels affect EV predictions.

kalman.note: causal smoother, not proof of signal quality

rank: EVgross = stop_fraction*(p*mean_positive_R + (1-p)*mean_nonpositive_R). EVnet subtracts roundtrip taker fee, halfspread and slippage and conservative last-known adverse funding if holding may cross settlement. Score = EVnet / expected hold minutes for1x capital. Fill candidates only if EVnet>0; expected return and duration are estimates. No reallocation from same-minute intrabar exits.
alternatives_fixed: price-only ablation, EV without time divisor, probability ranking with EV filter, and 5bps extra EV buffer. All defined before outcomes; no optimizer search after final holdout.

costs.note: assumed scenarios, not user fee tier nor reconstructed historical spread

execution: market-only adverse spread+slippage, current exchange tick/lot/min-notional scenario, re-floor qty after price rounding, qty cap at min(lot,marketlot); <=0.1% PREVIOUSminute quote volume, funding boundary before entries, intrabar favorable funding credit excluded if uncertain, time exits at open, stop-first, full closing costs in DD. No orders/accounts.
comparison: Reapply frozen R17.24/R17.25 volume impulse signal/risk/7day exit on SAME3symbols/calendars using1m execution, full latency and costs. Also compare six ML variants with identical risk. Not a full replay of production baseline R16.24.2.
selection_gate: July-Oct best normal-cost compounded return among ML variants with PF>1, >=100 trades, DD<=20%, positive3/4months and positive stress compounded return. Otherwise choose CASH for November. Select same variant for stress. All variants still diagnostic-reported final period, not used for promotion.
promotion: No automatic main merge. Require selected ML >=5%monthly equivalent AND outperform control under both costs, Sharpe>=1, PF>=1.2, >=100testtrades, positive final period and no model calibration degradation versus fixed train-prevalence Brier baseline. Forward paper required.
robustness: Fixed132trees, causal real-data prefix tests, calibration metrics, paired comparisons, 500block-bootstrap daily return paths for selected/control; no inference of significance from all trial-best without multiplicity correction. Negative labels-shuffle training sanity test with fixed seed on first fold, not a full permutation search p-value.
